changes.evidence: In Across the Spider-Verse, Society member Peni stays behind during the chase and then joins Gwen's team, after Gwen is exiled by Miguel, to rescue Miles, a splinter group working against the Spider-Society (Marvel Database lists Spider Society as a former affiliation). This is the same move already recorded for Peter B. Parker, Hobie and Gwen. Add left title "Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse" (as on Peter B. Parker and Hobie Brown's records).

In Across the Spider-Verse, Margo chooses not to stop Miles at the Go Home Machine against Miguel, then joins the team Gwen assembles to rescue Miles, a splinter group working against the Society (Marvel Database lists Spider Society as a former affiliation; its trivia says the team-up implies she has left). This is the same move already recorded for Peter B. Parker and Hobie. Add left title "Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse" (as on Peter B. Parker and Hobie Brown's records).

At the end of Across the Spider-Verse, Society member Pavitr joins the team Gwen gathers after Miguel exiles her, 'a splinter group of spider heroes to work against the Spider Society' (Marvel Database, Peter B. Parker page), to rescue Miles. This is the same move already recorded for Peter B. Parker and Hobie. (Pavitr's own Marvel Database page still lists Spider Society, so the confidence is medium.) Add left title "Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse" (as on Peter B. Parker and Hobie Brown's records).

At the end of Across the Spider-Verse, Mayday comes with her father Peter B. into Gwen's splinter team against the Spider-Society to rescue Miles. Peter B.'s record already records this as leaving the Society; Mayday's record keeps her in it. (Marvel Database lists her Society tie only as a 'day pass'.) Add left title "Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse" (as on Peter B. Parker and Hobie Brown's records).
